doc: Overworld script for Palm Brinks (m01). It places the player on arrival, sets up the invention bridge parts by story progress, and handles the doors to Cedric's shop (i01h01) and the other buildings, the square (s45), the station (i02h01), the Underground Channel entrance (d01e01) and the Zelmite Mine dungeon (stage 6, after flag 800). It plays Cedric walking off to the mayor (event 109) and Need's request to find Zelmite that starts chapter 8 (event 800), blocks doors in the demo build, and holds several camera test scenes for debug entries.
